It extends the shared campus design within the native and embedded scope; orange primary fills and the serif welcome are intentional local exceptions. The original visual flag stays off by default; later functional additions do not change its scope.
keyCharacteristics: Manrope interface type with one welcoming serif moment.
Orange identity, readable accent ink, and quiet light/dark surfaces.
Pending academic work before courses, tools, and calendar.
Soft cards, comfortable controls, and restrained motion.

rules.name: The Confirmed Course Checkpoint Rule
rules.body: Latest user clarification selects original fourth screenshot for thumbnail card and exact first-phase handoff for interiors. Preserve recovered styles and instructor customization; old-Git restoration and route exclusion are superseded.

rules.name: The Fill and Ink Rule
rules.body: Brand orange is a fill or indicator; small accent text uses separate light/dark accent ink in eligible presentation, including course content.

dos: Do keep the native presentation behind its shared auth-derived context and default-off build flag.
Do use accent ink for small orange foregrounds and validate actual light/dark contrast pairs.
Do preserve live API values, native controls, safe areas, offline behavior, recovery, and existing route semantics.
Do verify large type, both themes, native gestures, and assistive technology on the declared devices before acceptance.
donts: Don't extend these native exceptions into authentication, onboarding, other institutes, unsupported roles, or the shared web design system.
Don't mutate global Text/defaultProps, invent course art, or import illustrative concept data.
Don't replace the confirmed thumbnail card or recovered interior checkpoint with old Git geometry, a top banner, a route exclusion, or a new visual interpretation.
Don't report browser fixtures or successful compilation as native accessibility or performance evidence.
Don't expand the authorized student-header, top-Labs-removal and announcement-Meet amendment into another card or classwork redesign.
